readOnly: Viewing only: changing these settings needs site administrator rights.

bar.label: Unsaved changes
bar.saved: Saved. Page heads, robots.txt, sitemaps and llms.txt follow the new settings from the next request; a CDN in front of the site may keep the old copy until its cache expires.
bar.conflict: Someone changed these settings meanwhile. Discard to load their version, then make your change again.

errors.needsTitle: Include {title}, or leave empty for the default.
errors.publicationName: Give the publication name news sitemaps require.
errors.token: A crawler token takes letters, digits, “.”, “_” and “-”.
errors.notBound: This domain is not bound to this site.

preview.sampleDescription: The first lines of a published article appear here.
preview.noDescription: No description: search engines pick text from the page.
preview.notIndexed: Search engines are asked not to index this site.

cite.yes: AI assistants can read and cite this site's articles.
cite.partly: AI assistants can cite this site only in part: one of search and user fetches is blocked.
cite.no: AI assistants will not read and cite this site's articles.

train.yes: AI companies may use the articles to train models.
train.no: AI companies are asked not to train models on the articles.

preview.notSaved: A preview: nothing changes on the site until you save.

appearance.title: Search appearance
appearance.explain: How the site's pages appear in search results: the title and description templates every page uses unless it sets its own.
appearance.placeholders: Placeholders: {title} the page title, {site} the site name, {description} the page description.
appearance.indexSite: Let search engines index this site
appearance.indexSiteHint: Off: every page asks not to be indexed (noindex).

crawlers.title: AI crawler policy
crawlers.explain: Which AI crawlers may read the site, by what they read it for. The policy is written into robots.txt; crawlers that follow it stop reading what it blocks.

purposeHint.search: Crawlers that index pages for AI search answers.
purposeHint.user-fetch: An assistant reading a page because someone asked about it.
purposeHint.training: Crawlers that collect text to train models.

crawlers.contentSignalHint: States in robots.txt what the content may be used for.
crawlers.more: Also set: {{overrides}} crawler override(s), {{custom}} site crawler(s).

machine.title: Machine-readable output
machine.explain: What the site offers to programs besides its pages: summaries for AI, Markdown copies, feeds and change notices to search engines. Structured data is checked on the left.
machine.llmsHint: A map of the site for AI assistants.
machine.markdownHint: Each article also at its address with .md.
machine.feedsHint: RSS and Atom of the latest articles.
machine.indexNowHint: Tell search engines at once when a page is published or changed.

canonical.title: Canonical domain
canonical.explain: The address search engines should treat as the site's own. The site's other active domains redirect to it, except language entries.
canonical.label: Canonical domain
canonical.hint: One of the domains bound to this site.
canonical.none: No active domain is bound to this site yet: add one under Sites › Domains.
canonical.saved: Saved. Other domains redirect here from the next request.

identity.title: Site identity
identity.explain: Who the site speaks for. Search engines and AI assistants read it from the structured data of every page.

rootFiles.title: Root files
rootFiles.explain: Files served at the site's root that the system does not write itself, such as ads.txt or verification files.

redirects.title: Redirects
redirects.explain: Old addresses and where they go. Import from CSV or another plugin's export; the check shows what would change before anything is written.
redirects.importHint: CSV (from,to,code) or an export of Redirection, Yoast or Rank Math.
